names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 ianuarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Ιανουαρίου, «Οσία Δομνίκη», with the rank word left off.
Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 8 января ст. ст., «Домника Константинопольская, игумения», with the office left off. The day's line gives the forename alone.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life gives no year, only reigns: she came to Constantinople «pe vremea împărăției marelui Teodosie (379-395)» and reposed «ajungând la adânci bătrâneți, până pe vremea împărăției lui Leon (457-474) și a lui Zenon (474-491)». The interval is those two reigns end to end.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 января ст. ст. — «Прп. Домники (ок. 474).»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs and the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Întru tine, maică, cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip; că, luând crucea, ai urmat lui Hristos; şi lucrând, ai învăţat să nu se uite la trup, căci este trecător; ci să poarte grijă de suflet, de lucrul cel nemuritor. Pentru aceasta şi cu îngerii împreună se bucură, Preacuvioasă Maică Domnica, duhul tău.

english.text: In thee, O Mother, that which was made after God's image was kept safe with care; for taking up the cross thou didst follow Christ, and by thy labour thou didst teach us to pay no heed to the flesh, since it passes away, but to take thought for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore, O venerable Mother Domnica, thy spirit rejoices together with the angels.

hymns.text: Αγάπη τή κρείττονι, καταυγασθείσα τον νουν, ασκήσει εξέλαμψας, ώσπερ λαμπάς φαεινή, Δομνίκα πανεύφημε όθεν Μοναζουοών σε, όδηγόν φωτοφόρον, έδειξεν ο Δεσπότης, δια βίου και λόγου. Ω πρέσβευε θεοφόρε, σώζεσθαι άπαντας.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), Οσία Δομνίκη — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος δ'. Ταχύ προκατάλαβε

english.text: Your mind lit up by the better love, you shone out in ascetic labour like a bright lamp, Domnica of all praise; and so the Master showed you, by your life and by your word, to be a light-bearing guide of nuns. Intercede, God-bearer, that all may be saved.
